title: CEYO Transparency Log Checkpoint
description: A signed assertion of a Merkle tree root and tree size. A valid checkpoint authenticates the signed checkpoint body under an externally selected verification key; it does not by itself establish freshness, global consistency, or independently trusted time.

tree_size.description: Number of log entries represented by the signed root.

created_at.description: Signer-asserted checkpoint creation time. It is covered by the checkpoint signature, so later editing is detectable; signing alone does not prevent replay of the entire checkpoint or prove clock accuracy.

sig.description: ECDSA-P256-SHA256 signature over the RFC 8785 canonical form of checkpoint_body. The legacy descriptor string remains accepted for checkpoint-format compatibility.

covers.description: New checkpoints use RFC8785(checkpoint_body). canonical(checkpoint_body) is retained only as the legacy descriptor for checkpoints generated before the canonicalization profile was made explicit.

key_reference.description: Descriptive reference to the checkpoint signing key. In checkpoint format 1.0 this object is outside the signed checkpoint body; verifiers must obtain the trusted checkpoint public key through an external trust path and must not treat this field alone as authenticated signer identity.

public_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key SPKI DER. The standalone verifier may use it as a consistency check against the externally supplied checkpoint key.
